open_interest.reliability_scope: Fresh rendered quantities and their arithmetic are diagnostic-only. Inherited predecessor and chart/header consistency remain unresolved; no reliable approximately hourly OI baseline or recovery is inferred.

predicted.conversion: Header displayed percent divided by 100; predicted rate, not settlement.

funding.limitation: Historical chart-local labels do not establish UTC settlement time or latest settled event.

visible_depth.precision_note: Size and cumulative values are independently compact-formatted; exact sums are not inferred.

mark_prior_hour_comparison.limitation: Actual primary-to-primary capture gap; no interpolation or rescaling to one hour. Prior values only used in this labelled historical comparison.

alert_assessment.rule: JCT only: reliable approximately hourly absolute quantity OI change >=5% OR latest closed1h volume >=2 times six-prior arithmetic mean AND same-bar absolute body >=3% OR approximately hourly primary mark absolute change >=10%; candidate requires second fresh same-contract confirmation.
alert_assessment.note: Unknown/unreliable OI is not a false/no-change result. Informational symbols do not inherit the JCT alert rule.

cross_panel_windows.note: No common event window or UTC mapping inferred from matching labels.
